component.name: Refrain
component.summary: Discord Rich Presence for Apple Music on Linux

description.p: Refrain shows what you are listening to on Apple Music as your Discord status — whether the audio is playing in your browser (music.apple.com) or streaming from your iPhone over Bluetooth.

ul.li: Reads playback metadata from MPRIS (Apple Music in any major Linux browser)
Reads playback metadata from BlueZ AVRCP (any AVRCP-capable Bluetooth source)
Forwards track info plus iTunes-resolved cover art to Discord
System-tray icon with Play / Pause / Next / Previous controls
Settings window for sources, privacy mode, autostart and Bluetooth device picker

description.p: Same-day follow-up to v0.1.3 fixing the two issues v0.1.3 shipped with: AppImage filename was rendered as "Refrain-.version.-x86_64.AppImage" because of a broken {version} placeholder, and the AppImage icon wasn't bundled because the icon_bundler walks XDG icon paths but the recipe used files.include. Both fixed. Plus AUR refrain and refrain-git are now live, and the Flatpak manifest is validated locally end-to-end against KDE 6.10 + the PySide BaseApp.

Start-on-Login now works for venv / pipx / pip --user installs (the autostart .desktop no longer assumes `refrain` is on $PATH at session-startup time). The noisy Qt XDG-portal warning is suppressed in the live log. PyPI publishing is wired into the release workflow via Trusted Publishers, so installs via `pip install refrain` now Just Work.

More production-readiness: empty Discord client_id no longer spams reconnect attempts, the cover-art toggle is now actually honored by the desktop notification, AppImage restart uses $APPIMAGE explicitly, the AppImage build recipe was fixed, and the tray menu shows a Discord connection indicator. Reset-to-defaults and Open-log-folder buttons added to Settings → Advanced.
Reliability fixes for desktop notifications, in-app Restart (tray + Settings), CodeQL false-positive suppressions, and minor dead-code cleanup.
